title: Windows & Doors PPC Management Services
html:
One Campaign per Product Line

Replacement projects get the highest bids. Repair searches can't drain the budget meant for full installs, and each campaign sends clicks to a page about that product.

  • Product-based campaigns
  • Replacement ad groups
  • Location targeting
  • Call assets
  • Separate budgets

Example bid priorityReplacement windowsHighEntry doorsHighPatio doorsMidSpecialtyMidRepairsCap

Illustration only. Real bids follow your margins and cost per booked estimate.

Separate Buyers From Browsers

A homeowner typing "replacement windows near me" is ready for an estimate. A homeowner typing "how to replace a window" is not. That keeps your budget on shoppers who are ready to book.

  • Intent-based ad groups
  • Negative keywords
  • Match type control
  • Weekly search term review
  • Service area exclusions

Example searches, by intentwindow replacement companyBid highentry door installationBid highhow to replace a windowBlockedwindow parts near meBlocked

Reach Homeowners on More Than One Search Engine

  • Google Ads search
  • Microsoft Advertising
  • Shared negative keywords
  • Separate budgets
  • Cross-platform reporting

How the platforms fitGoogle AdsMain paid channelMicrosoft AdvertisingSecond channel, added laterNegative keywordsShared across bothBudgetsJudged on their own

A Page That Matches the Search

A patio door search lands on a patio door page, not your homepage. Each page shows project photos, product details, reviews, an estimate form and a click-to-call button. A page that matches the search also gives each campaign a clear job to do.

  • Product landing pages
  • Project photo galleries
  • Estimate request forms
  • Click-to-call buttons
  • Fast mobile pages

Count Booked Estimates, Not Clicks

Google Ads can then learn which searches turn into paying customers. Your monthly report shows cost per lead and cost per booked estimate for each product line, so you see which products earn their budget.

  • Call tracking numbers
  • Form tracking
  • Offline conversion imports
  • Cost per booked estimate
  • Monthly reports

Windows and Doors PPC Management Strategies

These four strategies keep your ad budget on high-value window and door projects and away from searches that never turn into estimates. Each one follows how homeowners compare products before they call.

Replacement Project Campaigns

Full window replacements, entry doors and patio doors get their own campaigns and the highest bids. A single repair search never shares their budget, so big projects keep getting funded first.

Negative Keyword Cleanup

  • diy
  • how to
  • parts
  • hardware
  • screen repair
  • window cleaning
  • tinting
  • blinds
  • curtains
  • shutters
  • jobs
  • hiring
  • salary
  • used
  • home depot
  • lowes

How Our Windows and Doors PPC Management Process Works

Keep a campaign group if its cost per booked estimate fits what a sold job is worth to you.

Should Your Window and Door Company Use PPC?

Start PPC when your team can answer calls and run estimates, because paid search only delivers shoppers. If any item on the right applies, fix it first and start later.

Start PPC now if

  • You sell replacement windows, entry doors or patio doors at a high ticket price.
  • Your crews and sales team can take on more in-home estimates right now.
  • Someone answers the phone during the hours your ads run.
  • You know what a sold job is worth in profit.

PPC vs SEO for Window and Door Companies

PPC wins when you need estimate requests soon, and SEO wins when you want lasting lead flow without paying for every click. Most installers need both, in that order.

FactorPPCSEO
AudienceHomeowners searching right nowHomeowners researching and comparing
CostAd spend plus a management fee, every monthA monthly fee, with no cost per click
Speed to first leadsFaster, once campaigns are approvedSlower, because pages must earn rankings
TargetingProduct, location, schedule and device you chooseKeywords mapped to pages across your service area
Best forFilling your estimate calendar nowBuilding lead flow that lasts

Is PPC worth it for window and door companies?

PPC is worth it for window and door companies with a high ticket price and a team ready to run estimates. Ads reach homeowners searching right now, so strong campaigns fill your calendar.

How much does PPC management cost for a window company?

You pay two things: a flat monthly management fee and your ad spend, which goes straight to the ad platform. Your ad budget depends on your service area, your competition and how many products you advertise.

Should we use PPC or SEO?

Use both, in order. PPC fills your estimate calendar faster, because ads can run once campaigns are approved. SEO takes longer but lowers your reliance on ad spend.

How fast does PPC bring window and door leads?

Ads can start bringing calls and form requests soon after your approved campaigns go live. Reliable decisions take longer, because window and door buyers compare quotes for weeks.

Why do my window ads get clicks but no estimates?

Clicks without estimates usually come from broad searches such as repairs, parts or do-it-yourself guides.
